title: 第一部：母亲的葬礼与烈日下的海滩
titleEn: Part 1: Mother’s Funeral & The Sun-Drenched Beach

sentences.chinese: 今天，妈妈死了。也许是昨天，我不知道。我收到了养老院发来的一封电报：“母死。明日安葬。节哀。”这并没有说明什么。也许是昨天死的。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān ， mā mā sǐ le 。 yě xǔ shì zuó tiān ， wǒ bù zhī dào 。 wǒ shōu dào le yǎng lǎo yuàn fā lái de yī fēng diàn bào ： “ mǔ sǐ 。 míng rì ān zàng 。 jié āi 。 ” zhè bìng méi yǒu shuō míng shén me 。 yě xǔ shì zuó tiān sǐ de 。
sentences.english: Mother died today. Or maybe yesterday, I don't know. I had a telegram from the home: "Mother deceased. Funeral tomorrow. Deep sympathy." That doesn't mean anything. Maybe it was yesterday.

sentences.chinese: 我向老板请了假，乘车前往八十公里外的马伦戈养老院。在守灵室里，我喝了门房递给我的牛奶咖啡，抽了烟，却没有在母亲的棺木前哭泣。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiàng lǎo bǎn qǐng le jiǎ ， chéng chē qián wǎng bā shí gōng lǐ wài de mǎ lún gē yǎng lǎo yuàn 。 zài shǒu líng shì lǐ ， wǒ hē le mén fáng dì gěi wǒ de niú nǎi kā fēi ， chōu le yān ， què méi yǒu zài mǔ qīn de guān mù qián kū qì 。
sentences.english: I took leave from my boss and caught the bus to Marengo. At the vigil, I drank white coffee offered by the gatekeeper and smoked, but did not weep before my mother’s coffin.

sentences.chinese: 第二天，在灼热刺眼的阳光下，我参加了漫长的葬礼。一切都发生得平静而自然，我只感到炎热与疲倦。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān ， zài zhuó rè cì yǎn de yáng guāng xià ， wǒ cān jiā le màn cháng de zàng lǐ 。 yī qiē dōu fā shēng dé píng jìng ér zì rán ， wǒ zhǐ gǎn dào yán rè yǔ pí juàn 。
sentences.english: The next day, under the blazing sun, I walked the long funeral procession. Everything happened calmly and naturally; I felt only heat and exhaustion.

sentences.chinese: 回到阿尔及尔后，我遇见了以前的女同事玛丽，我们一起去游泳，看了费南代尔的喜剧电影，晚上她留在了我的公寓。
sentences.pinyin: huí dào ā ěr jí ěr hòu ， wǒ yù jiàn le yǐ qián de nǚ tóng shì mǎ lì ， wǒ mén yī qǐ qù yóu yǒng ， kàn le fèi nán dài ěr de xǐ jù diàn yǐng ， wǎn shàng tā liú zài le wǒ de gōng yù 。
sentences.english: Back in Algiers, I ran into Marie, a former coworker. We went swimming, watched a Fernandel comedy film, and she spent the night at my apartment.

sentences.chinese: 周末，邻居雷蒙德邀请我们去海边的木屋度周末。烈日当空，炽热的阳光像刀刃一样刺痛着沙滩。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu mò ， lín jū léi mēng dé yāo qǐng wǒ mén qù hǎi biān de mù wū dù zhōu mò 。 liè rì dāng kōng ， chì rè de yáng guāng xiàng dāo rèn yī yàng cì tòng zhuó shā tān 。
sentences.english: On the weekend, my neighbor Raymond invited us to a beach cabin. The blinding sun beat down mercilessly upon the sand like a razor blade.

sentences.chinese: 在泉水边，我独自遇到了那名跟踪雷蒙德的阿拉伯人。阳光如熔化的铅水般沉重，汗水流进我的眼睛，模糊了视线。
sentences.pinyin: zài quán shuǐ biān ， wǒ dú zì yù dào le nà míng gēn zōng léi mēng dé de ā lā bó rén 。 yáng guāng rú róng huà de qiān shuǐ bān chén zhòng ， hàn shuǐ liú jìn wǒ de yǎn jīng ， mó hú le shì xiàn 。
sentences.english: Near the spring, I encountered the Arab man who had followed Raymond. The heat was like molten lead; sweat stung my eyes, blinding my vision.

sentences.chinese: 阿拉伯人拔出了匕首，刀刃上的反光如同一把长剑刺入我的前额。我扣动了扳机。我击碎了那天的平静，又对着那具瘫倒的躯体连开了四枪，短促而有力，仿佛敲响了厄运的四声丧钟。
sentences.pinyin: ā lā bó rén bá chū le bǐ shǒu ， dāo rèn shàng de fǎn guāng rú tóng yī bǎ cháng jiàn cì rù wǒ de qián é 。 wǒ kòu dòng le bān jī 。 wǒ jī suì le nà tiān de píng jìng ， yòu duì zhuó nà jù tān dǎo de qū tǐ lián kāi le sì qiāng ， duǎn cù ér yǒu lì ， fǎng fó qiāo xiǎng le è yùn de sì shēng sàng zhōng 。
sentences.english: The Arab drew a knife; the reflection flashed like a steel blade into my forehead. I pulled the trigger. I shattered the balance of the day, then fired four more shots into the inert body—four short, sharp knocks on the door of unhappiness.

title: 第二部：审判、荒诞与面对浩瀚宇宙的宁静
titleEn: Part 2: The Trial, The Absurd & Peace with the Universe

sentences.chinese: 我被捕了，关进了监狱。在法庭上，检察官并没有过多关注杀人案件本身，而是紧紧抓住我在母亲葬礼上没有流泪这一细节。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bèi bǔ le ， guān jìn le jiān yù 。 zài fǎ tíng shàng ， jiǎn chá guān bìng méi yǒu guò duō guān zhù shā rén àn jiàn běn shēn ， ér shì jǐn jǐn zhuā zhù wǒ zài mǔ qīn zàng lǐ shàng méi yǒu liú lèi zhè yī xì jié 。
sentences.english: I was imprisoned. At the trial, the prosecutor focused not on the homicide, but on the fact that I had shed no tears at my mother’s funeral.

sentences.chinese: 他们称我为一个“灵魂里没有一丝人性温暖的冷血怪物”，并判定我为全社会的公敌。
sentences.pinyin: tā mén chēng wǒ wèi yī gè “ líng hún lǐ méi yǒu yī sī rén xìng wēn nuǎn de lěng xiě guài wù ” ， bìng pàn dìng wǒ wèi quán shè huì de gōng dí 。
sentences.english: They denounced me as a "cold-blooded monster devoid of human warmth," declaring me an enemy to civil society.

sentences.chinese: 我被判处死刑，将在广场上公开斩首。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bèi pàn chù sǐ xíng ， jiāng zài guǎng chǎng shàng gōng kāi zhǎn shǒu 。
sentences.english: I was sentenced to death by public beheading in a town square.

sentences.chinese: 在狱中，神甫前来劝我向上帝忏悔，试图将救赎强加于我。我爆发了，抓住他的衣领怒吼道：没有任何一种神圣的幻觉比真实的生命更值得执着！
sentences.pinyin: zài yù zhōng ， shén fǔ qián lái quàn wǒ xiàng shàng dì chàn huǐ ， shì tú jiāng jiù shú qiáng jiā yú wǒ 。 wǒ bào fā le ， zhuā zhù tā de yī lǐng nù hǒu dào ： méi yǒu rèn hé yī zhǒng shén shèng de huàn jué bǐ zhēn shí de shēng mìng gèng zhí dé zhí zhuó ！
sentences.english: In my cell, the prison chaplain urged me to confess to God. I erupted, grabbing his collar, shouting that no holy illusion was worth the reality of life!

sentences.chinese: 神甫走后，夜幕降临，繁星涌现。我第一次向这个冷漠而温柔的世界敞开了我的心扉。
sentences.pinyin: shén fǔ zǒu hòu ， yè mù jiàng lín ， fán xīng yǒng xiàn 。 wǒ dì yī cì xiàng zhè gè lěng mò ér wēn róu de shì jiè chǎng kāi le wǒ de xīn fēi 。
sentences.english: After the chaplain left, quiet night fell and the stars emerged. For the first time, I opened my heart to the benign indifference of the universe.

sentences.chinese: 我发觉世界是如此像我，如此充满兄弟般的情谊，我感到我曾经是幸福的，现在依然是幸福的。为了让我不感到那么孤独，我只希望行刑的那一天有很多人前来观看，并向我报以仇恨的呼喊。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ fā jué shì jiè shì rú cǐ xiàng wǒ ， rú cǐ chōng mǎn xiōng dì bān de qíng yì ， wǒ gǎn dào wǒ céng jīng shì xìng fú de ， xiàn zài yī rán shì xìng fú de 。 wèi le ràng wǒ bù gǎn dào nà me gū dú ， wǒ zhǐ xī wàng xíng xíng de nà yī tiān yǒu hěn duō rén qián lái guān kàn ， bìng xiàng wǒ bào yǐ chóu hèn de hū hǎn 。
sentences.english: Finding the world so like myself, so brotherly, I felt I had been happy and was happy still. To feel less lonely, I had only to wish that on my execution day a vast crowd of spectators would greet me with cries of hatred.
